svg.title: HTTP waits: one versus two compute workers at 2,000 offered requests per second

cc:Work.dc:title: HTTP waits: one versus two compute workers at 2,000 offered requests per second
cc:Work.dc:description: The main matrix uses one fiber compute worker; the supplement uses two, within the same two application CPUs. Virtual-thread controls retain two carriers and are fresh independent repetitions. Markers are medians of three per-run class fractions; whiskers show observed ranges, not confidence intervals.
